title: Noncompact Iwasawa factorization and translationally equivariant hyperbolic affine spheres
summary: We establish the noncompact Iwasawa factorization for a Delaunay-type potential associated with affine spheres on the complex plane away from countably many lines. Using the DPW method, we give an explicit description of the factorization in terms of Weierstrass elliptic functions via a reduction to a linear system related to the Tzitzéica equation. As an application, we construct explicit translationally equivariant hyperbolic affine spheres and classify them according to their slice curves.
